name: Neutraubling (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically black and yellow, charged above the centre with the city arms of Neutraubling (a red cross and a cogwheel on white and black).
history: The city arms, designed by the local historian Josef Fendl, and the black-yellow striped flag with the arms shifted upward were approved by the Minister of the Interior on 21 August 1969.
